findings.title: Finance rejects the public Company Identity attestor result.
findings.detail: Finance defines a strict receipt with only decisionId, contentDigest, and scope. Company Identity returns its full FinanceThbPolicyApprovalReceipt with receipt version, signer, decision evidence, rules, validity, replay identity, and audit fields. A real allow or replay result therefore fails FinanceThbValuationError with FINANCE_THB_POLICY_APPROVAL_INVALID before evidence access.
findings.strategy_evidence: test-strategy-phase2-thb.md:98-105 requires Finance to consume the public Company Identity attestor and forbids a duplicate receipt verifier.
findings.reproduction: A provider-neutral probe returned the Company Identity receipt shape and received FINANCE_THB_POLICY_APPROVAL_INVALID with zero evidence reads.
findings.impact: A real Company Identity caller cannot prepare a THB valuation.
findings.required_disposition: Remediate the Finance-to-Company-Identity result boundary before acceptance.

findings.title: Capture can bypass strict unknown-key rejection for __proto__.
findings.detail: capture assigns captured values with output[key] = value. An own enumerable __proto__ key with a primitive value is not retained as an own key. Strict request and evidence schemas then accept the remaining shape. The replay classifier also returns replay for operands that contain this unknown key.
findings.reproduction: A request with own __proto__: "secret" reached the attestor. Evidence with the same key was accepted. Replay operands with the key returned {status: replay}.
findings.impact: The required strict request, evidence, and replay contracts do not reject every unknown key.
findings.required_disposition: Preserve every own key during capture or reject the key before schema parsing.

findings.title: The THB strategy status is stale after Green implementation evidence.
findings.detail: The strategy says the THB task is [~] because Red tests are active. The plan marks the implementation task [x]. Owner rate-source, rounding, and effective-date decisions remain deferred, but the strategy does not distinguish that policy gate from implementation status.
findings.impact: The active strategy can misstate the current implementation state.
findings.required_disposition: Reconcile the status text without claiming owner policy acceptance.
